instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Prepare sign-ups and payments to send back to Meta Ads and Google Ads", and give it project; visits (First-touch visits: one per visitor, with the click ids they arrived with); conversions (What each visitor did: outcome, time, value, email or phone); destinations (Where conversions go, each turned on with its account and which outcome is which event).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:prepare-ad-conversions and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: the sends, each a connection tool (tool:meta-ads-send-conversion-events or tool:google-ads-send-conversions) with its exact input, and the conversions skipped with why. Email and phone are hashed; the plain values never appear. This Workshop does not offer the Meta Ads or Google Ads send tools yet, so nothing is sent from here.
